title: hibiscus racemosus
intro: Hibiscus racemosus, commonly known as Rosella, is a plant species that belongs to the mallow family (Malvaceae) and is native to tropical regions of Asia and Australia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, lowering blood pressure, and aiding in digestion. The therapeutic actions of Hibiscus racemosus include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Hibiscus racemosus include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and ascorbic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
